name: Lucy Stark
tagline: Top rated Securities & Corporate Finance attorney in Denver, Colorado
about: Lucy Stark is an attorney providing legal services covering Securities & Corporate Finance, Business / Corporate and Mergers & Acquisitions.

Lucy Stark, who practices law in Denver, Colorado, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2012 - 2027. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at University of Colorado Law School. She graduated in 1998. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 1998.
